title: SimBench-BW CUPTI Activity sidecar
description: Per-launch CUPTI Activity API sidecar emitted by workloads/simbench_bw/cupti_activity_collector.{h,cu} alongside every kernel launch when run_suite.py is invoked with --enable-cupti-activity on --mode timing. Carries the per-launch wall-clock telemetry that, paired with the cudaEventRecord-derived wall_time_ms, defines the dual-source primary observable: a (kernel, repeat) measurement is admissible into the per-kernel MAPE input only when both timestamps reconcile within max(5% relative, 5us absolute). Cross-references: workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/measurement_manifest.schema.json (the parent timing manifest), tools/cloud/preflight_manifest.py (the preflight_manifest_sha256 anchor), workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/kernel_signature.spec.md (the kernel_signature_sha256 canonical inputs).

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema version. Bumped only when fields are added, removed, or change semantics. Drift detection in validate.py rejects sidecars with extra fields whose schema_version is not also bumped.

preflight_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the preflight manifest the run was anchored to. Computed via tools/cloud/preflight_manifest.compute_preflight_sha256(); ties the sidecar to the toolchain + capabilities snapshot in effect when the run started.

binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the kernel runner binary that produced this launch.

collector_binary_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cupti_activity_collector .so / executable that emitted the sidecar.

slug.description: SimBench-BW row slug (e.g. rmsnorm_fwd_bf16); matches workloads/simbench_bw/roster.toml conventions.

repeat_index.description: Zero-based index of the repeat within this (slug, shape_point) cell.

launch_index.description: Zero-based index of this kernel launch within this (slug, shape_point, repeat) tuple. A single repeat may launch multiple kernels.

kernel_name.description: Demangled kernel symbol name as reported by CUPTI.

kernel_signature_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical kernel-signature inputs defined in workloads/simbench_bw/schemas/kernel_signature.spec.md. Used to join CUPTI-side and NVBit-side launches in the offline two-run merge handled by workloads/simbench_bw/merge_evidence.py.

kernel_correlation_id.description: CUPTI correlation_id from the kernel activity record.

stream_id.description: CUDA stream id the kernel was launched on.

context_id.description: CUDA context id the kernel ran under.

regs_per_thread.description: Per-thread register usage as reported by CUPTI.

shared_mem_static_bytes.description: Static shared-memory allocation per block, bytes.

shared_mem_dynamic_bytes.description: Dynamic shared-memory allocation per block, bytes.

start_ns.description: CUPTI Activity kernel record start timestamp, nanoseconds. The collector binds CUPTI's timestamp source to host CLOCK_MONOTONIC via `cuptiActivityRegisterTimestampCallback` so this value shares the clock domain with the matched per-repeat NVML covariate sidecar's `samples[].timestamp_ns`. When the timestamp-callback registration fails AND NVML emission was requested, the collector exits with the typed runtime-unavailable code instead of writing records on a different clock domain.

end_ns.description: CUPTI Activity kernel record end timestamp, nanoseconds (same CLOCK_MONOTONIC source as start_ns). Must satisfy end_ns >= start_ns.

duration_ns.description: end_ns - start_ns. Recorded explicitly so consumers do not have to recompute.

cuda_event_wall_time_ms.description: Host-side wall-clock duration for this launch, captured via cudaEventRecord/cudaEventElapsedTime around the kernel. Co-required primary observable for the dual-source wall-clock contract (paired with CUPTI Activity duration_ns; admissible into the per-kernel MAPE input only when both sources reconcile within the dual_source_reconciliation_passed gate).

dual_source_reconciliation_gap_ns.description: Signed delta duration_ns - cuda_event_wall_time_ms * 1e6. May be negative when the host event observed a longer duration than the CUPTI Activity record (e.g. host queueing overhead).

dual_source_reconciliation_passed.description: True iff abs(dual_source_reconciliation_gap_ns) <= effective_bound_ns under the canonical formula `effective_bound_ns = max(0.05 * cuda_event_wall_time_ms * 1e6, max(tolerance_ns_calibrated_or_5000, 5000))`. The `tolerance_ns_calibrated` field of workloads/simbench_bw/golden/cupti_dual_source_tolerance.json is the calibrated ABSOLUTE FLOOR — it can only RAISE the absolute branch above the spec-default 5000 ns; the relative 5% branch is always honored, so longer-duration kernels see the looser 5%-of-duration bound. When the fixture's calibrated value is null, the formula reduces to the spec-default `max(0.05 * cuda_event_wall_time_ms * 1e6, 5000)`. Both the collector library and the validator compute this identical formula.

memcpy_records.description: CUPTI Activity memcpy records observed during this launch's lifetime. May be empty for kernels with no associated memcpys.

memset_records.description: CUPTI Activity memset records observed during this launch's lifetime.

collector_status.description: 'ok' when every required Activity kind enabled successfully; 'degraded' when one or more optional Activity kinds returned CUPTI_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES (recorded in degraded_activity_kinds[]).

dropped_records_count.description: Number of CUPTI Activity records the collector observed but could not retain (buffer-overflow / drained-during-shutdown / etc.). Zero is the normal case.

cupti_flush_reason.description: Origin of the cuptiActivityFlushAll(0) call that produced this sidecar's records.

buffer_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the CUPTI Activity callback buffer the collector allocated.

deployment_mode.description: Snapshot of the deployment-mode capabilities the collector observed at startup. Sidecars from MIG-enabled or CC-on regimes are not admissible (those manifests are rejected at preflight time).

enabled_activity_kinds.description: Activity kinds the collector enabled successfully on this run. Required: _KERNEL, _CONCURRENT_KERNEL. Optional: _MEMCPY, _MEMSET, _DRIVER, _RUNTIME, _OVERHEAD, _DEVICE, _CONTEXT, _SOURCE_LOCATOR.

degraded_activity_kinds.description: Optional Activity kinds for which cuptiActivityEnable returned CUPTI_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES. The collector continues with collector_status='degraded'. Required-kind failures exit the collector with typed CuptiKernelTimestampUnavailable instead of degrading.

kind.description: CUPTI memcpy kind enum, surface form (host-to-device, device-to-host, etc.).

value.description: Byte value the memset wrote (one byte). CUPTI exposes this as uint32_t but only the low byte is the memset value.

activity_kind.description: CUPTI Activity kind enum surface form (suffix only; the CUPTI_ACTIVITY_KIND prefix is implicit). Limited to the kinds the wall-clock telemetry contract recognizes — required (`_KERNEL`, `_CONCURRENT_KERNEL`) and optional (memcpy / memset / driver / runtime / overhead / device / context / source-locator). Profiling-equivalent kinds (PC_SAMPLING, EVENT, METRIC, INSTRUCTION_EXECUTION, INSTRUCTION_CORRELATION, PC_SAMPLING_RECORD_INFO, SASS_METRIC) are NOT admissible per the CUPTI Profiling blocklist enforced in tests/test_no_root_or_ncu_static_guard.py.
